title: Migrate RCU-on-VM resident publication into the SMP worktree
summary: Port only the verified ResidentRoot/EBR VM slices from codex/rcu-on-vm into codex/test-remote-network, then wire them to the existing SMP per-hart lifecycle with bounded maintenance and 1-hart/2-hart gates.

write_sets.notes: Claimed only for this migration; preserve unrelated dirty hunks and exclude network, ext4, PELT, and broad HAL changes.

external_refs: selection: verified RCU/VM slices only; include the bounded pmap gather API required by those slices; exclude source progress metadata, ext4, network, PELT, and unrelated HAL/reactor WIP
dirty-state rule: preserve all pre-existing target user and SMP/ext4 WIP; overlapping files require narrow patches

steps.title: Freeze baselines and write claims
steps.notes: Record source/target identity by path and branch, preserve dirty state, and reject broad migration.

steps.title: Close SMP queue/owner and runnable/polling linearization gaps
steps.notes: Queue membership, TaskRunOwner, and TaskTable lifecycle must become observable as one transition.

steps.title: Initialize VM cleanup/range transaction state on BSP and AP harts
steps.notes: Closed as an explicit deferred boundary: the target tree has no vm/range_txn.rs, so source init_vm_range_txn_hart/drain_local_vm_cleanup was not imported. No production per-hart VM cleanup claim is made.

steps.title: Run bounded EBR drain, VM cleanup, and zone maintenance per hart
steps.notes: Maintenance IPI only acknowledges and marks pending; normal context performs bounded 64-entry local EBR service plus zone maintenance before WFI. Full VM range cleanup remains deferred with p2.

steps.title: Port ResidentRoot publication and guarded resident hit path
steps.notes: Verified ResidentRoot/publication and guarded hit path ported independently of the deferred VM hart lifecycle; production reclaim still depends on p2/p3.

steps.title: Port generation-checked withdrawal and the required VM/page consumers
steps.notes: Generation-checked withdrawal, page consumers, IO manager closure, and focused lifecycle/direct-I/O/reflink coverage are ported. Existing VM RangeLock/MapPin/shootdown ownership is unchanged.

steps.title: Run 1-hart/2-hart acceptance and close progress records
steps.notes: Host gates and paired RV64 1-hart/2-hart smoke acceptance are complete. SMP1 has boot-only evidence because no remote hart exists; SMP2 has owner-wake and all six RCU markers.

verification.notes: Run on all claimed edits and newly created records.

verification.command: cargo test -p tx-reactor --test scheduler --test userspace_run --test hart_loop
verification.notes: Focused SMP host gate; pair with one-hart/two-hart runtime evidence when available.
Resident-root ratchet unit test passed; direct xtask lint also passed.

Passed after retaining the compatibility FsPageBacking::prepare_write_range default, using TruncateOp constructors, and routing close writeback through queue_dirty_file_writeback; existing warnings remain.
tx-shims 663, tx-kernel 119, tx-ext4 73 plus 2 ignored, and tx-scripts 168 host tests passed.
Doctor, RV64 kernel build, and smoke initramfs image completed.
Boot sentinel observed; no remote-hart RCU probe is expected at SMP1.
Boot, owner-wake, and rcu:smp cpus/guarded-overlap/no-early-reclaim/maintenance-ack/bounded-drain/ok markers observed in target/qemu-rv64-qemu-smoke-smp2.serial.log.

blockers: Target worktree has extensive pre-existing dirty WIP; overlapping files require narrow patches.
Source worktree has unrelated ext4/network/HAL/reactor dirty changes that are explicitly excluded.
Host tests and the two-hart smoke do not prove every full VM hart interleaving.
VM range transaction per-hart lifecycle (init_vm_range_txn_hart/drain_local_vm_cleanup) is not ported because it requires a broad recipe_arena/range_txn VM rewrite.
Existing docs lint may remain blocked by the untracked .io-submission-patch/ artifact and external links.
risks: Target and source both modify PageBacked, VM, init, and reactor surfaces; a broad cherry-pick can overwrite SMP or ext4 WIP.
Guard, MapPin, RangeGuard, and retire reservations must not cross Yield, I/O, callbacks, or completion.
The source branch is dirty and contains unrelated ext4/network/HAL/reactor edits; those changes are not evidence for this migration.
Host tests are deterministic and do not prove every two-hart interleaving; a missing QEMU gate remains a documented blocker.
